summary: Several changes improve how pages behave and how Firefox handles their data: the `text-autospace-size` CSS property is now supported, the `color-scheme` meta tag affects `prefers-color-scheme`, and navigation and shadow-DOM features gain better support. Structured-clone data now carries its own version, with unknown versions rejected, and deserialization checks that secure-context requirements are met. Other updates make image maps, page loading, and content-list performance more reliable.
